text:
jordan: Heads up — main is red on CI after the onnxruntime bump to 1.13. Failing test: `onnx_inference_smoke` (segfault during session create).

samir: link to job: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/12345 — logs show `SIGSEGV` in ort::session::create at load_model.cpp:87

mei: can you paste the last-known-good commit? I can start a bisect if we have a good/bad pair.

jordan: last known good is `0a1b2c3d` (yesterday's green). HEAD is bad. Suspect PR: #5421 (bump onnxruntime 1.12 -> 1.13) merged ~3h ago.

lucy: Confirmed failing on linux-x86_64 CUDA11.8 runners only; cpu-only runners pass.

samir: I can run a quick local bisect. Which CI reproducer should I use?

jordan: `./scripts/ci/run_integration.sh --test onnx_inference_smoke --platform linux-cuda` — that's what CI runs.

samir: starting bisect locally now. Steps I'm doing:```bash
git fetch origin
git checkout main
git bisect start
git bisect bad HEAD
git bisect good 0a1b2c3d
# then run the reproducer per commit```
deploy-bot: Re-run of build 12345 has been queued by @samir :white_check_mark:

samir: quick update — bisect quickly narrowed to range, suspect commit: `f6e4b9a` which is the merge commit for #5421. Reproduces locally with same segfault.

mei: thanks — can we confirm by checking out `f6e4b9a` and running under gdb to get stack?

samir: did that, minimal backtrace: `/usr/lib/libonnxruntime.so` crashing inside `OrtCreateSessionFromModel`. Stack points at ABI change in session init (maybe new allocator flags).

lucy: if that's the PR, we should revert the merge and get CI green. I'll open a revert PR unless someone objects.

jordan: +1 revert. Also add a CI smoke job that runs on the cuda matrix for onnx tests so we catch this earlier.

mei: opening revert PR now — will include revert of #5421 and add a note to the PR template to run the cuda matrix locally.

lucy: revert PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/reverts/5500 — adding `Engineering` as reviewer and requesting fast-track.

deploy-bot: CI triggered for revert PR 5500 (build 12368) :arrow_up:

samir: once revert merges, we should mark the original PR to reattempt the bump behind a canary/deferred rollout.

jordan: agreed. Thanks for the quick bisect/confirm everyone. :thumbsup:

lucy: revert PR green and merged — CI on main went back to green. Will follow up on a guarded rollout plan for onnxruntime 1.13.

mei: filed follow-up issue #5510 to track canary rollout and add CUDA smoke.

jordan: resolved for now, closing the loop. Great job.
